# Hermetic conformance suite.
#
# One program per line, repo-relative. Generated by `cargo xtask corpus`.
#
# A program is listed when it passes two independent filters.
#
# 1. Hermetic: every word it invokes is pure, writes stdout, or writes a
#    diagnostic to stderr — no network, filesystem, image, database, bus,
#    clock, randomness, or host state.
# 2. In scope: no word it invokes has been deferred by a decision in
#    docs/registers/decisions.md.
# 3. Reproducible: the oracle produces identical output on two runs.
#    See tests/golden/UNSTABLE.txt — this one is empirical, and no
#    static analysis of word effects can derive it.
#
# Both classifications are derived from each word's registration site in
# reference/; see xtask/src/corpus/classify.rs for the rules and their
# citations.
#
# 59 of 132 programs qualify: 80 are hermetic, of which 59 are in scope.
#
# Hermetic but excluded by a scope decision:
#   reference/Bund/examples/ai/ollama_api_demo.bund  [D15] console presentation: spinners, animation, colour
#   reference/Bund/examples/code_snippets/string_wrap_demo.bund  [D15] console presentation: spinners, animation, colour
#   reference/Bund/examples/console/typewriter_demo.bund  [D15] console presentation: spinners, animation, colour
